name: 2D Vector & Sprite Rendering Pipeline
purpose: Design, implement, and profile high-performance 2D graphics rendering pipelines, dynamic multi-texture quad batching, premultiplied alpha blending, MaxRects texture atlas packing with bleed gutters, and MSDF vector typography.
inputs: Graphics API specification (WebGPU, Vulkan, Metal, OpenGL)
Target frame rate & render submission timing budget
outputs: Dynamic 2D quad batcher and vertex ring buffer implementations
Multi-texture binding and draw call aggregation routines
Texture atlas generator configurations with bleeding gutters
stop_conditions: Task acceptance criteria satisfied with evidence
Batching renders test scene in under 25 draw calls
Zero runtime dynamic heap allocations in render loop
